earnings.title: Cloudflare Announces Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results
highlights: GAAP loss from operations of $67.9 million, or 9% of total revenue, and non-GAAP income from operations of $137.1 million, or 18% of revenue
Revenue : Total revenue of $782.5 million, representing an increase of 39% year-over-year.
Operating Income (Loss) : GAAP loss from operations was $67.9 million, or 8.7% of revenue, compared to $37.5 million, or 6.7% of revenue, in the third quarter of 2025.
Third quarter revenue totaled $782.5 million, representing an increase of 39% year-over-year
Gross Profit : GAAP gross profit was $557.2 million, or 71.2% gross margin, compared to $415.7 million, or 74.0%, in the third quarter of 2025.

quotes.text: The third quarter was Cloudflare's best quarter ever. We crossed $3 billion in annualized revenue with revenue of $782 million, up 39% year over year.
quotes.by: Matthew Prince, co-founder & CEO of Cloudflare

outlook: Non-GAAP income from operations of $156.0 to $157.0 million
Non-GAAP net income per share of $0.43, utilizing weighted average common shares outstanding of approximately 379 million
